title: Putting Teams into the Gig Economy: A Field Experiment at a Ride-Sharing Platform
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment with a single contest period: drivers randomized into teams (and team-formation algorithms) vs control. Treatment effects are estimated on driver-level differences between the contest/post-contest windows and the pre-contest period (xtreg timediff/tripdiff/revdiff treated if dayone/gameday/twoweek/fourweek, be; reg ... treated + driver covariates), plus probit and IV (team responsiveness instrumented by home_sim) and dynamic within-contest regressions. All teamed drivers are treated at the same date; no staggered adoption.
design_notes: analysis.do on panel.dta, drivers.dta, responsiveness.dta (and no-replacement variants). Log of the real-data run: analysis_log_original_data.smcl. create_synthetic_dataset.do documents how the synthetic files were generated (set seed 0, deterministic assignment).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Single contest start date for all treated drivers.
data_files_note: README: 'All data files are synthetic as we cannot share the real data.'
software_notes: Stata xtreg/reg/probit/ivreg2; Python notebook for Figures 2-3.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Add to data/synthetic_packages.txt.
